environment.description: Same application container deployed on EKS cluster behind AWS Application Load Balancer. The ALB target group has an associated WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL includes a custom rule group with a single rule: a RegexPatternSet match on query string values using the pattern `(?i)('|--|;|union\s|select\s|insert\s|drop\s|alter\s|exec\s|xp_)` with action BLOCK, priority 1. Additionally, the WebACL has a second rule at priority 2: a SqliMatchStatement configured with FieldToMatch set to AllQueryArguments, TextTransformation URL_DECODE followed by LOWERCASE, with sensitivity level HIGH and action BLOCK. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm both rules are actively evaluating traffic.

rule_2.name: aws-sqli-detection
rule_2.statement: SqliMatchStatement on AllQueryArguments with URL_DECODE+LOWERCASE transforms, sensitivity HIGH

config.alb: internet-facing ALB with HTTPS listener, target group routing to EKS pods
config.note: WebACL associated to ALB ARN, all traffic passes through WAFv2 evaluation before reaching application
